omnibus.note: The omnibus rejects, which licenses the pairwise family. It does not correct the pairwise p-values -- Holm below does.

m3_2_detector_family_matrix.reason: The 56 cells are per-family true-positive rates, not hypothesis tests -- there is no p-value to correct. The matrix is reported descriptively and no significance is claimed between cells.
